summary: P01 V2.47.235 refines the Owner Navigation category projection after Production V2.47.234 exposed every historical 0-count active category and made the daily category rail noisy. The Owner daily browse tree now hides historical zero-count shells by default, while a newly created or currently selected empty category remains immediately visible. The existing Sort panel is the complete active-category management projection and includes 0-count categories with edit/reparent/delete access, while category_reorder continues to persist the complete active sibling set. Public empty-category suppression remains unchanged. This release does not alter canonical Category mutation semantics, Schema/Migration, auth/session/security semantics, updater mechanism, provider/server state or Production. Production remains Owner-manual.
